immutable_ground_truth.statement: The dataset provides daily records for the billing queue in us-east region for two distinct baseline windows: May 8–14, 2026 and June 5–7, 2026.
The May 8–14 period is annotated as 'same weekday minus five weeks' relative to an unspecified reference point.
The June 5–7 period is annotated as 'previous week same weekday' relative to an unspecified reference point.
All records have a non-null value for new_tickets, p95_first_response_minutes, billing_tag_share, and staffed_hours.

potentially_conflicting_assertions.assertion: The May baseline uses 'same weekday minus five weeks' while the June baseline uses 'previous week same weekday', implying different temporal alignment strategies.

source_summary: CSV containing daily metrics for the billing queue in us-east region for two baseline periods: one period labeled 'same weekday minus five weeks' (2026-05-08 to 2026-05-14) and one period labeled 'previous week same weekday' (2026-06-05 to 2026-06-07). Columns include new tickets per day, p95 first response time in minutes, billing tag share, and staffed hours.
